title_sq: Tek Komuna e Parisit, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2 Ideal Per Banim!!!
description_sq: Tek Komuna e Parisit, shitet super apartament 3+1+2 i Bollshem. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 8 te nje pallati 9 katesh te mireadministruar me ashensor te ndertuar ne vitin 2002 dhe organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje te bollshem dhe me dalje ne ballkon ,ambientin e gatimit te ndare me vete nga salloni dhe me dalje ne ballkon, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale me dalje ne ballkon dhe dy dhoma gjumi te tjera gjithashtu me dalje ne ballkon, dhe dy tualete njeri prej te cileve me dritare. Apartamenti eshte shume i mirembajtur. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i mobiluar ku perfshiihet salloni i ndenjes ambienti i gatimit, tre dhomat si dhe te dy tualetet. Orientimi eshte nje pike e forte e ketij apartamenti pasi ka 3 orientime jug lindje dhe perendim cka e ben nje apartament te ekspozuar ndaj drites se diellit ne pjesen me te mire te dites gjithashtu ka dhe pamje te lire nga kopshti botanik. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje zone e cila eshte shume e kerkuar pasi ofron te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme per nje jetese sa me komode, me ajer te paster dhe nje zone mjaft e qete. Apartamenti disponon dhe nje garazhd te mbyllur per shitje bashk me nje depo me cmim 40,000euro.
title_en: In the Municipality of Paris, Apartment 3+1+2 Ideal for Living!!!
description_en: In the Municipality of Paris, a spacious 3+1+2 super apartment is for sale. The apartment is located on the 8th floor of a well-managed 9-story building with an elevator built in 2002 and is organized in a spacious living room with access to the balcony, a separate kitchen from the living room with access to the balcony, a master bedroom with access to the balcony and two other bedrooms also with access to the balcony, and two bathrooms, one of which has a window. The apartment is very well maintained. The apartment is fully furnished, including the living room, kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. The orientation is a strong point of this apartment as it has 3 orientations south, east and west, which makes the apartment exposed to sunlight for the best part of the day, it also has an unobstructed view of the botanical garden. The area in which the apartment is located is an area that is very sought after as it offers all the necessary services for a comfortable life, with clean air and a quite quiet area. The apartment also has a closed garage for sale together with a warehouse for 40,000 euros.
